name: sweep the tank 1.00 -> 0.00 and record which frame the gauge picks
every frame is used, in order, no skips and no reversals
eval: (function(){const idx=[];for(let k=0;k<=200;k++){const f=1-k/200;window.__BO.forceFuel=f;applyForces();paintFuel();idx.push(Math.round(parseFloat(window.__BO.fuelFrame())/100*14));}const uniq=[];for(const i of idx)if(uniq.length===0||uniq[uniq.length-1]!==i)uniq.push(i);let mono=true;for(let i=1;i<uniq.length;i++)if(uniq[i]<uniq[i-1])mono=false;const missing=[];for(let i=0;i<=14;i++)if(uniq.indexOf(i)<0)missing.push(i);return 'sequence '+uniq.join(',')+'  | monotonic '+mono+'  | frames never shown: '+(missing.length?missing.join(','):'none');})()
